notes.title: Early Access Update v0.80 - UNSTABLE
notes.content:
Hello folks!

I come here with good news!

I've just released the update v0.80 to the UNSTABLE BRANCH.
I released it this way so I can test and improve a few things before releasing on the "normal" branch.
If you want to try it, just enable it on your steam (roll down for how to). But, please, first read the warnings below.
If you prefer a stable version, it's going to take a few more days (explanation below).

[b] Attention! Saves from older (stable) versions are going to corrupt the game. Please start a new game.[/b] 

[b] Warning! The unstable version may contain major bugs (including save bugs). If you don't want to get mad about them, please wait a little for the stable version. Also, only english and portuguese are available yet.[/b] 


[h1]ABOUT THE DELAY[/h1]
Unfortunately, this update became far bigger than I expected and includes so many stuff that wasn't intended when I've planned the game or created the roadmap that I got somewhat swamped.
Also I had a number of setbacks since last Xmas, so it took way more time than expected.
Moreover, just for mere statistics, it was + 600h of work in almost 3 months, from Monday to Monday. It was almost like having developed an Evil Labs 2.
The good thing about this is that I believe I've been able to use many ideas and suggestions from the community to build a better game. But you can tell me later ;)
Anyway, without further delays, the succinct Version 0.80 ChangeLog...

[h1]CHANGELOG V0.80[/h1] 
[b]What's new:[/b]
- Totally revamped UI with new UI elements
- Added 4 new products to produce and sell
- Added 15 new buildings (8 factories, 2 labs, 2 staff, 2 storerooms, 1 admin)
- Added 12 new researchs (and modified a dozen more)
- Added new mechanics to disease creation (save, name, etc) 
- Added new mechanics to clients
- Added new mechanics to infection system
- Added raw material mechanics (buy the material needed to fabricate your meds)
- Added price system (raw material cost changes each day)
- Added regional mechanics (buy and upgrade stores on each region)
- Added logistics mechanics (pay to ship your meds to your regional stores)
- Added info buttons (general help)
- Added time mechanics
- Added report system
- Added six world regions with different characteristics
- Clients now have specific products demands regarding to their infection
- Staff daily cost
- Regional stores daily cost
- New Easter Eggs
- Dozens of new character/buildings animations
- Hundreds of new text
- New jokes (I hope =X )
- Many other new stuff!

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Player initial money raised to $5000
- Re-balanced buildings cost
- Re-balanced disease options
- Modified the way to expand the lab 
- The disease synth now can be builded anywhere in the lab
- Revamped infection system
- Revamped background/scenario
- Converted Spores + Protozoas to Parasites
- Removed the "general" cure (boxes)
- Reworked price system
- Various buttons icons changes
- Base espontaneous cure chance reduced
- Global population was removed
- Chaged the main storeroom

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Corrected various typos on all languages
- Fixed image display on some older PC setups (magenta screen)
- Fixed various bug related to the previous versions
- Various performance improvements

[h1]ABOUT THE NORMAL BRANCH RELEASE[/h1]
What's missing before releasing v0.80 to the regular branch?
At this time I have to:
1) Do few more general tests and bug fixing
2) Work a bit on the save system
3) Finish drawing the new sky background (for the day/night cicle)
4) Work better on the main storeroom script (It has been disabled for now)
5) Create the new tutorial
6) Wait for the spanish and russian translations (which is already being done by some awesome community members)

I'm also waiting this few days to get the feedback of the new version from you guys, so it becomes better on the official release ;)

Thank you all for the support during these last few months and I'm really sorry if I disappointed you with the delays.
I hope the new version is as much fun as it was for me to do it :)

If you have any questions, suggestions, bugs info, etc, please reach me out at contact@mirabolisstudios.com

See you soon!

notes.title: Early Access v0.74 Update
notes.content:
I've been receiving a lot of feedback from players and I am really glad. Thank you all! This is the way that we are going to make a great game. :)
About that, some players complained about the game having a slow start, so I improved the base stats for various buildings.
Also, some players talked about the infection system.
I redid the whole system and now infected customers pay more for the cure according to the disease strength.
Until now, the disease strength defined whatever customers came or not to the store. 
There are more things I am aware of and that I am going to work over the next updates. Sorry for any inconvenience caused.

Long story short, here is what changed...

[b][u]Early Access v0.74 Changelog:[/u][/b]

[h1]What's new:[/h1]
- Added some buildings in the background (still not the definitive version, so tell me what you guys think about how it looks like now ^^)
- Added sick customers balloons
- Added new customers emotion balloons
- Added life recovery automation for staff
- Added staff basic needs sliders, so player can define when staff start auto-recovering
- After selecting staff, when mouse is over a free workplace, it gets a highlight
- Added mouse camera movement, ativated by pressing the scroll bar button (kinda jagged, but I am going to work on it over the next update)

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
- Now hunger balloon starts to be displayed when workers hunger gets to 5%
- Stamina base recovery improved in 10%
- Hunger and Fun base recovery improved in 20%
- You can now easily select staff when it is behind clients (although it was not a bug, it was really anoying)
- Removed character description on the character info menu (the right menu)
- Now infected customers pay more for the cure according to the disease strength

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
- Fixed Steam achievements for tutorial and scenarios
- Goods price now show correctly after loading the game
- Removed the doubled lamps on the warehouse
- Candies, softdrinks and magazines now sell properly
- Camera doesn't move anymore when typing the save name
- Fixed a bug that make some workplaces disappear after firing a staff
- Fixed a bug that sometimes locked up workplaces
- Fixed a bug that prevented world population stats from loading correctly
- Non working staff now shouldn't appear behind working staff
- Fixed a bug which happened the second time the player tries to finish the tutorial
- Goods text are now correctly displayed in portuguese and spanish
- Various other save/load improvements and fixes
- Other minor bug fixes and improvements

[h1]About the next update:[/h1]
- New buildings will be added (including the Genetics Lab and the Necrotics Lab)
- I am going to add the possibility to change the keyboard keys for the camera
- Other stuff

See you in the next update!

Tiago

notes.title: Update v0.73a HotFix 2
notes.content:
Last time I had to disable building on pause mode because of a critical bug. An I am really sorry for any inconvenience caused.

I redid the building system of the game, changing the collison method, to fix a number of issues.

So, to short story, this is what changed:

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
- The player now can build with the game paused, 1x and 3x...
- The camera movement now works in a fixed value, so the player can move the camera even with the game paused

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
- Fixed the paused build issue
- Fixed a bug that happened when a staff died while using the elevator
- Fixed an error that occured while launching the game in 32-bit
- Fixed a bug that let the player build in some weird places
- Some more minor repairs

[h1]Short-term plans:[/h1]
- I plan to add an option to let the player change the camera speed/sensitivity in one of the next updates, this should make the game more confortable to play

Oh! And if you have any issues with your game after this update please let me know as soon as possible. As much as I have tested the new collision method and the 32bit fix, there may be some issues that may happen on specific system configurations that I am not aware of.

See you soon!

Tiago
